<thought>To calculate the DBE for the molecular formula C9H9NO3, I will first retrieve the DBE calculation formula using the provided tool, then apply it: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 + 1. Plugging in C=9, H=9, N=1 gives DBE = 9 - 4.5 + 0.5 + 1 = 6. The result is an integer.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
